subject: Purchase code origination sleuthing + line item amnesty
messages:
From: Ethan Long <ethan.long@auroralabs.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Cc: vendor-ops@auroralabs.com
Date: Wed, 7 Jul 2026 16:12:00 -0400
Subject: Mismatch on onboarding PO and spend cap - Aurora Labs

Hi Monica / Ben —

We just received the provisional onboarding package from Redwood but noticed two problems we need help with before we can sign off:

1) The provisional PO number (TEMP-482) shows a single line item SKU "RL-GPU-XL" quantity 1 for $25,000, but our intake form listed two SKUs ("AL-INFER-1" qty 2) that map to $40k total.
2) The spend cap reflected in the ledger is $25,000; our committed monthly spend for the pilot is $40,000 — we need a provisional cap that matches the pilot.

I've attached our completed onboarding form and the vendor intake PDF for reference (aurora_onboarding_form.pdf). Can someone advise the fastest path to get a corrected PO issued and a temporary spend-cap bump while we work through procurement approvals?

Thanks —
Ethan Long
Head of Platform Partnerships
Aurora Labs
ethan.long@auroralabs.com
+1 415 555 0123

From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
To: Ethan Long <ethan.long@auroralabs.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 7 Jul 2026 17:05:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Mismatch on onboarding PO and spend cap - Aurora Labs

Hi Ethan — thanks for the clear note and for attaching the form.

Quick summary / next steps from our side:
- Ben and I will triage the SKU mismatch and re-run assignment to the correct ledger tags.
- I can provisionally increase the spend cap to $45,000 for the pilot window while procurement confirms the formal approval (PR ticket created: PR-7832).
- Procurement will issue a corrected provisional PO with the right line-level breakdown once we have your billing tax ID + final SKU mapping.

Can you confirm the billing contact and tax ID (EIN) in reply? If you have a simple mapping (your SKU -> our SKU) in a sheet, please attach — otherwise we will send a template.

For visibility: Ben (on activation) will coordinate the onboarding ticket; Markus (procurement) will reissue the PO.

Thanks,
Monica Patel
Senior Program Manager, Onboarding
Redwood Inference
monica_patel@redwood.com

From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Ethan Long <ethan.long@auroralabs.com>
Date: Wed, 7 Jul 2026 18:20:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Mismatch on onboarding PO and spend cap - Aurora Labs

Thanks — looping in the procurement lane.

On Wed, Jul 7, 2026 at 5:05 PM Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com> wrote:
> Hi Ethan — thanks for the clear note and for attaching the form.
> 
> Quick summary / next steps from our side:
> - Ben and I will triage the SKU mismatch and re-run assignment to the correct ledger tags.
> - I can provisionally increase the spend cap to $45,000 for the pilot window while procurement confirms the formal approval (PR ticket created: PR-7832).
> - Procurement will issue a corrected provisional PO with the right line-level breakdown once we have your billing tax ID + final SKU mapping.

I reviewed the intake and the temp PO. My plan:
- I'll issue an updated provisional PO (serialized ID: 23-RW-4491) that breaks out two line items to match Aurora's requested SKUs. That PO will be marked as "Provisional - Subject to Approval" and be valid for 14 days.
- Ledger tag for accounting will be CLOUD-ENG-2026 (please confirm currency — I see USD on the intake).
- I'll attach a SKU mapping template (sku_mapping_template.xlsx) — Ethan, if you fill the left column with your SKUs (AL-*) and the right column with Redwood catalog SKUs, we can push the corrected PO same-day once I have the mapping and tax ID.

Action items:
- Ethan: provide tax ID + completed SKU mapping sheet (or confirm that the onboarding form's SKU list is final).
- Monica/Ben: confirm the provisional spend cap bump in PR-7832 and flag for finance approval (I will expedite).

I'll proceed to draft 23-RW-4491 as soon as mapping is received.

Regards,
Markus Klein
Head of Procurement
Redwood Inference
markus_klein@redwood.com

From: Ethan Long <ethan.long@auroralabs.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, vendor-ops@auroralabs.com
Date: Wed, 7 Jul 2026 20:03:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Mismatch on onboarding PO and spend cap - Aurora Labs

Markus / Monica — thanks, appreciate the quick turn. Attached: corrected SKU mapping and our tax info (EIN: 12-3456789) and a signed onboarding confirmation. I've also attached a corrected invoice example for your reference (corrected-invoice-AL-07.pdf).

Confirming:
- Currency: USD
- Billing contact: Accounting Team <acct-pay@auroralabs.com>
- We accept provisional PO 23-RW-4491 with the two-line breakdown as a temporary measure while PR-7832 proceeds.

If you need anything else from our side, shout — otherwise please send the finalized provisional PO and I'll route internally.

Best,
Ethan
On behalf of Aurora Labs Vendor Ops
